title: ರಾಂಚಿ
overview: Ranchi, a Kannada film directed by Shashikanth Gatti, takes audiences on a riveting journey as a struggling filmmaker delves into a seemingly innocuous Railway documentary project, only to unravel a well-oiled crime syndicate. Led by Prabhu Mundkur and Divya Uruduga, the film seamlessly blends elements of suspense, crime, and documentary storytelling.
